title: Life Plan and Care Transfers — Move-Out Carpet Cleaning When an Independent Living Resident Moves Into Larkspur Care
content:
The move-out carpet cleaning fee charged when an apartment under the Independent Living Residency Agreement is vacated follows where the resident is moving, and the closing amount carries that same fee.

## Rule

- A resident whose notice states a move to a Larkspur memory care residence **and** whose Memory Care Residency Agreement residency is active is charged **0 percent** of the carpet cleaning fee — nothing.
- A resident whose notice states a move to a Larkspur assisted living residence **and** whose Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement residency is active is charged **50 percent** of the carpet cleaning fee, rounded to the cent half up.
- Any other resident is charged the full carpet cleaning fee of the apartment type.

Both parts of each condition must hold: the move recorded with the notice, and an active residency of that care product for the customer.

## Fees by apartment type

| Apartment type | Full carpet cleaning fee | Assisted living move (50 percent) | Memory care move (0 percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 165.00 | 82.50 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 185.00 | 92.50 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 205.00 | 102.50 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 235.00 | 117.50 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 260.00 | 130.00 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 310.00 | 155.00 | 0.00 |

## Combinations

| Notice states | Active care residency of the customer | Carpet cleaning fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| Move to Larkspur memory care | Memory Care Residency Agreement active | 0 percent |
| Move to Larkspur memory care | No active memory care residency | Full fee |
| Move to Larkspur assisted living | Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement active | 50 percent |
| Move to Larkspur assisted living | No active assisted living residency | Full fee |
| Any other move | Any | Full fee |
